sentences.text: Lianghusuchus is an extinct genus containing only one species of crocodilian.
The species Lianghusuchus hengyangensis was named in 1948, and fossils date to the Eocene when they were found in Hunan, China.

Originally classified in the crocodile family Crocodylidae, Lianghusuchus was later reclassified into the alligator family Alligatoridae based on a 1999 study, and it belongs to the parent group Alligatoridae.
Lianghusuchus lived between 56 and 37.71 million years ago during the Ypresian to Bartonian stages.
